column3: Retains all who stood by him rather than explicitly attendants.
Retains both hearings without adding soon.
Retains the image of burning in their eyes.
Retains the midst of the land.
Retains going up and coming down.
Retains sons and sons of sons.
Retains eyes and mouth without adding Joseph’s name.
Retains the repeated neck rather than an embrace.
Retains go and come rather than explicitly return.
Retains the good of the land.
Retains you are commanded without adding to tell them.
Does not add shekels as a named unit.
Retains the broader agitation rather than explicitly quarrelling.
